scope: Promote the M1-qualified Core, Telos and Agate candidates to the active production pins of oramasys. Merged 2026-10-18 after operator approval and acceptance of the generation-2 hosted evidence: the package file on main now installs the promoted pins, so this record's status is a label that matches that fact. Serving activation, T3, T4 and T5 are separate switches and stay off. The approved generation-2 manifest keeps its frozen pre-merge capability list (it still lists production-pin-promotion as disabled); this record supersedes that label and the frozen bytes are never edited. Phylax stays composition-only.

conditions: Generation-2 hosted evidence fails or is not accepted by the operator.
A promoted producer is found to regress a required positive module or a declared gate.
The registry snapshot at to_ref becomes unreachable or its bytes differ from to_sha256.
rollback.procedure: Record a new reviewed rollback disposition. Restore the from pins in a new generation and obtain a new approval. Never rewrite the archived generation-1 bytes and never reuse their approval for changed inputs.
